title: Senior Solution Consultant
description:
**India \-Remote**

title: SAT Counsellor – International Sales (US Market)
description:
**About the Role** 




 As an SAT Counsellor, you'll own the full sales cycle for our SAT test\-prep offering in the US market — engaging prospective students and parents, understanding their college\-admissions goals, and consultatively closing them into the right program. This is a target\-driven, individual\-contributor closing role where your product knowledge, empathy and communication skills directly drive enrollments and revenue.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage prospective students and parents in the US market via calls, video counselling, instant messaging (WhatsApp) and other channels to sell ACE Academy's SAT test\-prep courses.
* Understand each student's college\-admissions goals, academic background and timeline, and recommend the most suitable SAT program through consultative selling.
* Own the complete sales funnel from lead qualification and product demonstration to closing, enrollment and post\-sale relationship.
* Drive conversions through effective follow\-ups, strong objection handling, and clear articulation of the value of our SAT prep.
* Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly enrollment and revenue targets.
* Handle high\-value / premium student profiles while maintaining an exceptional customer experience.
* Maintain accurate lead, activity and pipeline records in the CRM.
* Deliver a student\-first experience that generates referrals and repeat business.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* 2–5 years of experience selling SAT / test\-prep or study\-abroad courses to US consumers (international EdTech sales strongly preferred).
* Bachelor's degree (graduation) in any discipline is required.
* Proven, documented track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth as an individual contributor.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication fluency is essential for engaging US students and parents.
* Strong understanding of the cultural nuances and buying behaviour of US\-based students and families.
* Ability to listen effectively, build trust, and approach prospects with patience and empathy.
* Proficiency with CRM tools / sales tracking software and basic MS Office.
* Familiarity with the SAT, US college\-admissions process, or the test\-prep industry is a strong added advantage.
* Comfortable working a 6\-day week on a US\-aligned night shift, including weekends.
* High\-energy, self\-motivated and results\-oriented, able to work fast and independently in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary plus uncapped performance\-based incentives.
* The chance to sell a Forbes\-recognised, globally trusted education brand.
* Warm, high\-intent leads from a large international market.
* WFH flexibility
